summary: The landing tab of The Barbarian: a dark editorial "Daily insight" hero card over a warm paper background, followed by an EGX30 index strip, a 2×2 watchlist grid, two trending Pit posts, and a horizontally-scrolling "Latest research" rail. It is a read-and-browse surface — an entry point into research, companies and discussion — with no trading affordances of any kind.

sections.name: Phone frame + scroll container (context, shared)
sections.description: The screen renders inside a 390×844 phone shell. All Home content lives in one vertically scrolling region that sits underneath a non-interactive status bar and above the shared floating bottom nav. The whole Home column plays an entry animation on mount.
sections.layout: Phone shell: width:390px; height:844px; border-radius:46px; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EDE8E2 0%,#E3DCD4 100%); box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(27,25,23,.20), 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.07). Scroll region: position:absolute; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; scrollbar-width:none; padding:54px 16px 124px; box-sizing:border-box → usable content width = 390 − 16 − 16 = 358px. Home root column: display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:22px; animation:bRise 240ms ease-out, where @keyframes bRise { from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(4px)} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)} }. Status bar overlay: position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:54px; z-index:6; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 26px; pointer-events:none; font:500 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Right glyph cluster: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; three bars all background:#1B1917 — 16×9px r2px opacity .85, 5×9px r1px opacity .5, 22×10px r3px opacity .85. Bottom scrim (shared): position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:118px; z-index:5; pointer-events:none; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(232,225,216,0) 0%,rgba(230,222,213,.34) 52%,rgba(227,220,212,.62) 100%).

sections.name: Greeting header row
sections.description: Avatar with a PRO badge, a two-line greeting, and a circular refresh button on the trailing edge. This is the first child of the 22px-gap column and carries its own 6px top padding.
sections.layout: Row: display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding-top:6px. Left group: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px. Avatar wrapper: position:relative; width:46px; height:46px; flex:none. Avatar: 46×46px; border-radius:999px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 4px,#E8E2DB 4px 8px). PRO badge: position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:-7px; transform:translateX(-50%); padding:3px 7px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:500 8px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; color:#F5F1EC. Greeting: font:300 25px/1.1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#1B1917. Subtitle: margin-top:3px; font:400 13px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D. Refresh button: width:42px; height:42px; flex:none; border:none; border-radius:16px; background:#F7F4F0; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); color:#1B1917; font:400 17px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms ease-out; active state transform:scale(0.94). NOTE: the refresh button has no onClick bound in the design file — behaviour is unspecified.

sections.name: Daily insight hero card (dark editorial)
sections.description: The screen's lead element: a tall dark card containing a kicker + open-glyph row, an inset near-black chart panel with an orange area chart and two frosted stat pills, a large two-line headline, and a supporting dek. Tapping the card opens the Research reader.
sections.layout:
Card: background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242120 0%,#1B1917 100%); border-radius:28px; padding:20px; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Inner content width = 358 − 40 = 318px. Top row: display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px. Kicker: font:400 10px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8E8781; padding-top:6px. Open glyph disc: width:38px; height:38px; flex:none; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(245,241,236,.09); color:#F5F1EC; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:400 15px/1 Outfit,sans-serif. Chart panel: position:relative; margin-top:12px; height:164px; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; background:#141312. SVG: width:100%; height:164; viewBox="0 0 318 164"; preserveAspectRatio="none"; display:block. Gradient 'bgrad' x1=0 y1=0 x2=0 y2=1: stop 0 = #E8621C @ stop-opacity .26, stop 1 = #E8621C @ stop-opacity 0. Area path d="M0,124 L27,116 L54,128 L81,100 L108,108 L135,80 L162,90 L189,60 L216,70 L243,46 L270,56 L318,32 L318,164 L0,164 Z" fill=url(#bgrad). Line: . Pill stack: position:absolute; top:14px; left:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; align-items:flex-start. Each pill: padding:7px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.42); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); font:500 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#F5F1EC; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Headline: margin-top:18px; font:300 31px/1.06 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#F5F1EC; contains a hard
line break after 'in'. Dek: margin-top:10px; font:400 13px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#8E8781.

sections.name: EGX30 index strip
sections.description: A flat black card showing the index level split into an integer part and a smaller decimal part, a ticker tag, an orange percent-change pill, a staleness label, and a trailing chevron. Despite the chevron it is NOT wired to any handler in the design.
sections.layout: Card: background:#1B1917 (flat, no gradient — deliberately different from the hero); border-radius:28px; padding:18px 20px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px. Left column: flex:1; min-width:0. Value row: display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:5px. Integer: font:300 42px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#F5F1EC; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Decimals: font:300 20px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#8E8781; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Ticker tag: margin-left:6px; font:400 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; color:#8E8781. Meta row: margin-top:8px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px. Change pill: padding:4px 9px; border-radius:999px; background:#E8621C; font:500 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#FFF; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Staleness label: font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#8E8781. Chevron: font:300 26px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#8E8781.

sections.name: From your watchlist (2×2 grid + delay disclaimer)
sections.description: A section header with a 'Manage' link, a 2-column grid of four ticker tiles that alternate dark/light in a checkerboard, and a data-provenance line beneath. Each tile carries ticker, Arabic name, a sparkline, price and percent change. COMI has an orange unread dot.
sections.layout: Header row: display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:12px. Label: font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7A736D. 'Manage': font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; cursor:pointer. Grid: display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px → each tile = (358 − 12)/2 = 173px wide, inner width 173 − 32 = 141px. Dark tiles (SWDY, TMGH): background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242120 0%,#1B1917 100%); border-radius:24px; padding:16px; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Light tiles (COMI, ORAS): background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:24px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); same transition/active. COMI only adds position:relative and an unread dot at position:absolute; top:16px; right:16px; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:999px; background:#E8621C. Tile internals: ticker font:400 17px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; colour #F5F1EC on dark / #1B1917 on light. Arabic name: margin-top:4px; font:300 11px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; colour #8E8781 on dark / #7A736D on light; dir="rtl". Sparkline SVG: width:100%; height:34; viewBox="0 0 130 34"; preserveAspectRatio="none"; display:block; margin:12px 0 10px; polyline fill:none; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linejoin:round; stroke = #3F6B52 when up, #A3402F when down. Footer: display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; gap:6px; price font:300 20px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; change font:500 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; colour #3F6B52 up / #A3402F down. Disclaimer: margin-top:10px; font:300 10px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#9A938C. Exact sparkline point sets — SWDY: 0,26 16,22 32,27 48,18 65,21 81,13 97,16 113,8 130,4 (stroke #3F6B52). COMI: 0,10 16,7 32,14 48,11 65,18 81,15 97,22 113,19 130,24 (stroke #A3402F). ORAS: 0,20 16,17 32,21 48,15 65,17 81,12 97,15 113,11 130,13 (stroke #3F6B52). TMGH: 0,8 16,12 32,10 48,16 65,14 81,20 97,18 113,25 130,23 (stroke #A3402F).

sections.name: Trending in The Pit (two post cards)
sections.description: A section label above a vertical stack of two light discussion cards. Each card shows a topic chip + a post-kind chip, a large serif-free title, an overlapping participant avatar stack ending in a dark '+N' disc, and a comment count.
sections.layout: Label: font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7A736D; margin-bottom:12px. Stack: display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px. Card: background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:24px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Inner width = 358 − 36 = 322px. Chip row: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px. Topic chip (solid): padding:5px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#F5F1EC. Kind chip (outline, ember variant): padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,98,28,.5); font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#E8621C; no letter-spacing. Kind chip (outline, neutral variant): padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.18); font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#5C554F. Title: margin-top:12px; font:300 20px/1.25 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#1B1917. Footer: margin-top:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between. Avatar stack: display:flex; align-items:center; each disc 26×26px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #F7F4F0; every disc after the first has margin-left:-9px. Hatch fills in order: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px); repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#CFC7BE 0 3px,#E0D9D1 3px 6px); repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#DED7CF 0 3px,#EFE9E2 3px 6px). Overflow disc: background:#1B1917; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#F5F1EC. Comment count: font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Card 1 = SWDY / Question (ember chip) / 3 hatch avatars + '+9'. Card 2 = Banking / Analysis (neutral chip) / 2 hatch avatars + '+4'.

sections.name: Latest research (full-bleed horizontal rail)
sections.description: A section label above a horizontally scrolling rail of three fixed-width dark cards, each with an uppercase kicker, a title pushed down by a fixed 36px spacer, and a read-time + date meta line. The rail bleeds to the phone edges by negating the 16px page padding.
sections.layout: Label: font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7A736D; margin-bottom:12px. Rail: display:flex; gap:12px; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none; margin:0 -16px; padding:0 16px 4px (so cards start flush with the page gutter but can scroll to the true screen edge). Card: flex:none; width:200px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242120 0%,#1B1917 100%); border-radius:24px; padding:18px; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Inner width = 200 − 36 = 164px. Kicker: font:400 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8E8781. Title: margin-top:36px; font:300 21px/1.2 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#F5F1EC. Meta: margin-top:12px; font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#8E8781; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Cards have no fixed height: intrinsic height comes from content, and all three stretch to the tallest (flex align-items default stretch). Driven by sc-for over the `research` array (3 items).

sections.name: Bottom navigation (shared) — Home active state
sections.description: The floating glass nav bar is shared across all screens. On Home the selection pill sits in slot 1 (no translate) and the home icon renders in accent-on-dark with a glowing dot beneath. Home renders no FAB and no composer bar (those belong to The Pit and Post detail).
sections.layout: Bar: position:absolute; left:16px; right:16px; bottom:22px; height:66px; z-index:7; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.58); backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(180%); display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 6px; box-sizing:border-box; box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(27,25,23,.26), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.30) inset, 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.13), 0 -8px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.05) inset. Selection pill (Home = slot 0, no transform): position:absolute; left:6px; top:6px; bottom:6px; width:calc((100% - 12px) / 4); border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.20) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 100%); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.32) inset, 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18); animation:bPill 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) where @keyframes bPill { from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1} }. Sheen: position:absolute; left:14px; right:14px; top:1px; height:1px; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.42) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%); pointer-events:none. Each tab: position:relative; z-index:1; flex:1; height:66px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px → tab width = (390 − 32 − 12)/4 = 86.5px. Active Home icon group: color:#FF8340; svg 21×21 viewBox="0 0 20 20" with <rect x=3 y=8 width=14 height=9 rx=3 fill=currentColor> and <rect x=7 y=3 width=6 height=4 rx=2 fill=currentColor opacity=.5>; plus an active dot 4×4px; border-radius:999px; background:#FF8340; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,131,64,.9). Inactive tabs: color:rgba(245,241,236,.76), same SVG, no dot.

components.name: Editorial hero card
components.description: Large dark tap-target card that leads the Home feed: kicker row with an open-glyph disc, inset chart panel with area+line chart and frosted stat pills, oversized headline, muted dek. Opens the Research reader.
components.styling: background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242120 0%,#1B1917 100%); border-radius:28px; padding:20px; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Headline font:300 31px/1.06 Outfit, letter-spacing:-0.02em, #F5F1EC. Dek font:400 13px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', #8E8781. Kicker font:400 10px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', letter-spacing:.16em, uppercase, #8E8781, padding-top:6px.

components.name: Open-glyph disc (↗)
components.description: Circular translucent affordance in the hero's top-right indicating the card opens a full reader.
components.styling: width:38px; height:38px; flex:none; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(245,241,236,.09); color:#F5F1EC; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:400 15px/1 Outfit,sans-serif.

components.name: Hero chart panel
components.description: Inset near-black rounded panel holding a full-bleed non-uniform-scaled area chart in accent orange, with an absolutely positioned pill stack at the top-left.
components.styling: position:relative; margin-top:12px; height:164px; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; background:#141312. SVG viewBox 0 0 318 164, preserveAspectRatio=none. Area fill = vertical gradient #E8621C .26 → #E8621C 0. Line stroke #E8621C, stroke-width:2, stroke-linejoin:round.

components.name: Frosted stat pill
components.description: Small translucent blurred pill overlaid on dark imagery/charts, used for index level and volume.
components.styling: padding:7px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.42); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); font:500 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#F5F1EC; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums.

components.name: Index strip card
components.description: Flat black summary strip: split-weight numeral (large integer + small decimals), ticker tag, accent change pill, staleness caption, trailing chevron.
components.styling: background:#1B1917; border-radius:28px; padding:18px 20px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px. Integer font:300 42px/1 Outfit, letter-spacing:-0.03em, #F5F1EC. Decimals font:300 20px/1 Outfit, #8E8781. Tag font:400 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', letter-spacing:.14em, #8E8781, margin-left:6px. Chevron font:300 26px/1 Outfit, #8E8781.

components.name: Accent change pill (solid)
components.description: Solid orange pill carrying a directional glyph plus percent — used for the headline index change only. Note it is accent orange, NOT the up/down semantic greens/reds.
components.styling: padding:4px 9px; border-radius:999px; background:#E8621C; font:500 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#FFF; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums.

components.name: Watchlist ticker tile
components.description: Square-ish tile with ticker, Arabic company name, a stretched sparkline, price and directional percent. Two skins — dark gradient and light paper — laid out in a checkerboard. The light skin can carry an unread dot.
components.styling: Dark: background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242120 0%,#1B1917 100%); border-radius:24px; padding:16px. Light: background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:24px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08). Both: transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Ticker font:400 17px/1 Outfit, letter-spacing:.02em. Arabic font:300 11px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', dir=rtl. Price font:300 20px/1 Outfit tabular. Change font:500 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' tabular.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: 9-point polyline chart stretched to the tile's inner width; colour encodes direction but price text and the ▲/▼ glyph carry the same information, satisfying the never-colour-alone rule.
components.styling: svg width:100%; height:34; viewBox="0 0 130 34"; preserveAspectRatio="none"; display:block; margin:12px 0 10px. polyline fill:none; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linejoin:round; stroke:#3F6B52 (up) or #A3402F (down).

components.name: Unread indicator dot
components.description: Small accent dot pinned to a card's top-trailing corner to mark new activity on that ticker.
components.styling: position:absolute; top:16px; right:16px; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:999px; background:#E8621C.

components.name: Section label
components.description: Uppercase letterspaced eyebrow above each Home block.
components.styling: font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7A736D; margin-bottom:12px (or in a space-between row when paired with an action link).

components.name: Inline action link
components.description: Small plain-text trailing link in a section header ('Manage').
components.styling: font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; cursor:pointer. No underline, no accent colour.

components.name: Pit post preview card
components.description: Light card summarising a discussion thread: topic chip + kind chip, title, participant avatar stack, comment count.
components.styling: background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:24px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Title font:300 20px/1.25 Outfit, letter-spacing:-0.01em, #1B1917.

components.name: Topic chip (solid)
components.description: Dark solid chip carrying a ticker or sector name.
components.styling: padding:5px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#F5F1EC.

components.name: Post-kind chip (outline)
components.description: Hairline-outlined chip naming the post type. Two variants observed on Home: ember (Question) and neutral (Analysis). Note the outline is an inset box-shadow, not a border, so it costs no layout box.
components.styling: padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif. Ember: box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,98,28,.5); color:#E8621C. Neutral: box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.18); color:#5C554F.

components.name: Participant avatar stack
components.description: Overlapping 26px discs with diagonal-hatch placeholder fills, terminated by a dark '+N' overflow disc. Each disc is ringed in the card background colour to punch it out of its neighbour.
components.styling: Discs 26×26px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #F7F4F0; margin-left:-9px on every disc after the first. Fills: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px), then (#CFC7BE/#E0D9D1), then (#DED7CF/#EFE9E2). Overflow disc background:#1B1917; font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic'; color:#F5F1EC.

components.name: Research rail card
components.description: Fixed-width dark card in a horizontal rail: kicker, a fixed 36px gap, title, then read-time + date meta.
components.styling: flex:none; width:200px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242120 0%,#1B1917 100%); border-radius:24px; padding:18px; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.98). Kicker font:400 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', letter-spacing:.14em, uppercase, #8E8781. Title margin-top:36px; font:300 21px/1.2 Outfit; letter-spacing:-0.01em; #F5F1EC. Meta margin-top:12px; font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic'; #8E8781; tabular.

components.name: Soft-raised icon button
components.description: Square-rounded light button used for the header refresh control; the same shape/shadow recipe appears elsewhere as the save button.
components.styling: width:42px; height:42px; border:none; border-radius:16px; background:#F7F4F0; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); color:#1B1917; font:400 17px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; transition:transform 200ms ease-out; active transform:scale(0.94).

components.name: Hatch avatar
components.description: Placeholder user avatar rendered as a 135° two-tone repeating stripe pattern, at 46px (header) and 26px (stacks). Stripe period scales with size: 4px/8px at 46px, 3px/6px at 26px.
components.styling: border-radius:999px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 4px,#E8E2DB 4px 8px) at 46px; repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px) at 26px.

components.name: PRO badge
components.description: Tiny dark capsule tab hanging off the bottom edge of the header avatar.
components.styling: position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:-7px; transform:translateX(-50%); padding:3px 7px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:500 8px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; color:#F5F1EC.

components.name: Data-provenance caption
components.description: Small muted line stating data delay and source, sitting directly under the watchlist grid. Required by the product rule that stale data is always labelled.
components.styling: margin-top:10px; font:300 10px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#9A938C.

copy.role: hero kicker (uppercased via CSS; source string is mixed-case)

copy.text:
What happened in
the EGX today?
Foreign investors turned net buyers for the first time in nine sessions. Where the money went.
Prices delayed 15 minutes · end-of-day EGX data

SWDY watchlist tile tap → Company screen (`p.goCompany` = `g('company')`, no nav change → nav stays on Home). Press state scale(0.98) / 220ms ease-out.
COMI watchlist tile tap → Company screen, same handler, same press state.

ORAS and TMGH tiles have NO onClick in the design — they still declare `transition:transform 220ms ease-out` and a scale(0.98) active style, so they look tappable but are inert. Treat this as a design omission and wire all four tiles to the company route.
'Manage' link tap → You screen (`p.goYou` = `g('you','you')`) — this one DOES change the bottom nav to the You tab.

All three research rail cards tap → Research reader (`p.goReader`). Press state scale(0.98) / 220ms ease-out.

Refresh button (↻): declares transition:transform 200ms ease-out and active transform:scale(0.94), but has no onClick bound. Intended behaviour is a data refresh; the design does not specify a spinner or result state.
Index strip: renders a '›' chevron but has no onClick and no transition/active style — it does not react to touch in the design.
Research rail: horizontal scroll, `overflow-x:auto` with hidden scrollbars (`scrollbar-width:none` plus a global `*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0;display:none}`). No snapping, no paging dots.
Main scroll: vertical, hidden scrollbar, no pull-to-refresh specified, no sticky/collapsing header — the greeting scrolls away with the content.

Bottom nav: tapping Home is a no-op when already active. The selection pill re-plays `bPill` (320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1), opacity 0→1) on tab change; the pill is positioned by slot, so tab changes are an opacity fade in the design, not a slide. Home renders no FAB and no composer bar.

STRUCTURE. Build the screen as a `CustomScrollView`/`ListView` inside a `Stack`: layer 0 = the scroll view with `padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 54, 16, 124)`, layer 1 = the 118px bottom scrim (`IgnorePointer` + `DecoratedBox` with a 3-stop `LinearGradient`), layer 2 = the floating nav bar, layer 3 = the status bar (`IgnorePointer`). Content column = `Column(crossAxisAlignment: stretch)` with 22px `SizedBox` separators (or `Column(spacing: 22)` on Flutter 3.27+). Wrap the whole column in a one-shot fade+slide (`AnimationController` 240ms, `Curves.easeOut`, `Offset(0, 4/height)` → `Offset.zero`) to reproduce `bRise`. FONTS. Two families only: `Outfit` (w200/w300/w400/w500) for display and UI, `IBM Plex Sans Arabic` (w300/w400/w500) for labels, numerals and Arabic. CSS `font: / ` maps to `TextStyle(fontWeight:, fontSize:, height:)` where `height` is the unitless number directly (e.g. `300 31px/1.06` → `fontSize:31, height:1.06, fontWeight:w300`). CSS `letter-spacing` in `em` must be converted to logical pixels: `letterSpacing = em * fontSize` (e.g. `-0.02em` at 31px → `-0.62`; `.16em` at 11px → `1.76`; `.14em` at 10px → `1.4`; `.1em` at 8px → `0.8`; `.06em` at 10px → `0.6`; `.02em` at 17px → `0.34`). Everywhere the design says `font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums`, set `fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]` — this covers the index value, all prices, all percent changes, comment counts, research meta, overlay pills and the status bar clock. CSS `text-transform:uppercase` is presentational: keep the source strings mixed-case in your model and uppercase at render (`.toUpperCase()` with a locale) so Arabic localisation is not corrupted. DARK CARD GRADIENT. Every "raised dark" surface is the same recipe: `LinearGradient(begin: Alignment.topCenter, end: Alignment.bottomCenter, colors: [Color(0xFF242120), Color(0xFF1B1917)])`. The index strip is the one exception — flat `Color(0xFF1B1917)`. Do not unify them. CHARTS. Both the hero chart and the four sparklines use `preserveAspectRatio="none"`, i.e. non-uniform scaling. Use a `CustomPainter` that maps viewBox coordinates independently on each axis: `dx = x / vbWidth * size.width`, `dy = y / vbHeight * size.height`. Hero viewBox is 318×164 rendered at 318×164, so scale is 1:1 there. Sparkline viewBox is 130×34 rendered at 141×34, so x is stretched by ≈1.0846 and y is unscaled — a naive `FittedBox`/uniform fit will be visibly wrong. Hero line: `Paint()..style=stroke..strokeWidth=2..strokeJoin=StrokeJoin.round..color=0xFFE8621C`; hero fill: same path closed down to y=164 with a vertical `LinearGradient` from `Color(0xFFE8621C).withOpacity(0.26)` to `Color(0x00E8621C)` via `Shader`. Sparklines: `strokeWidth=1.6`, `StrokeJoin.round`, colour `0xFF3F6B52` (up) or `0xFFA3402F` (down). Nothing is curved — all segments are straight lines. BLUR. Two `backdrop-filter` surfaces touch this screen: the hero overlay pills (`blur(14px)`) and the shared nav bar (`blur(26px) saturate(180%)`). Use `ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)) + BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX:, sigmaY:))`. CSS blur radius ≈ 2× Flutter sigma, so 14px → sigma ≈ 7, 26px → sigma ≈ 13; tune visually. Flutter has no `saturate()` in `ImageFilter.blur` — either compose `ImageFilter.compose` with a `ColorFilter.matrix` saturation matrix or accept the blur alone. Keep blurred layers few; each is a full-screen-layer cost. INSET OUTLINES. The post-kind chips use `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px ` — that is a 1px inner stroke that does NOT affect layout. In Flutter use `BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(width: 1, color: ...), borderRadius: ...)` and then reduce the chip's padding by 1px on each side (to `3px 9px` from `4px 10px`) if you need exact outer dimensions, because Flutter's `Border` is drawn inside but still expands the child's constraints. Alternatively paint the stroke with a `CustomPainter`/`ShapeDecoration` to preserve the exact 4px/10px padding. AVATAR STACK. Overlap via `Stack` with `Positioned(left: i * 17)` (26 − 9 = 17px pitch) rather than negative margins, and give each disc a 2px ring using `BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: Color(0xFFF7F4F0), width: 2))` drawn OUTSIDE the 26px circle (`Container(width: 30, height: 30)` with the ring, or a `boxShadow` with `spreadRadius: 2, blurRadius: 0`). The CSS `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px` is an outer ring, so total footprint per disc is 30px. HATCH FILLS. The placeholder avatars are `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, A 0 Npx, B Npx 2Npx)`. Flutter has no repeating gradient; paint it with a `CustomPainter` drawing 135° stripes clipped to a circle, or precompute a small tiling `ImageShader`. Period is 8px (4/4) on the 46px header avatar and 6px (3/3) on the 26px stack discs. TABLE OF EXACT SIZES to hard-code: content width 358, hero inner 318, watchlist tile 173 (inner 141), sparkline box 141×34, Pit card inner 322, research card 200 (inner 164), nav tab 86.5. Prefer deriving these from `MediaQuery` width minus the 16px gutters so the layout survives non-390pt devices; the only truly fixed dimensions are the research card width (200) and the hero chart height (164). SCROLL DETAILS. Hide scrollbars (`ScrollConfiguration` with `scrollbars: false`). The research rail is a `SingleChildScrollView(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal)` that must bleed past the page gutter: give the rail `padding: EdgeInsets.only(left:16, right:16, bottom:4)` and let it occupy the full 390pt width — easiest is to lift it out of the padded column (`OverflowBox`/negative-margin equivalent) or to un-pad the whole list and pad each section individually. Rail cards stretch to equal height (`IntrinsicHeight` or `CrossAxisAlignment.stretch` in a `Row`) because the CSS flex default is `stretch`. PRESS FEEDBACK. Everything tappable uses `transform: scale(0.98)` over `220ms ease-out` (the refresh button uses `scale(0.94)` over `200ms`). Implement one reusable `PressableScale` widget wrapping `GestureDetector` + `AnimatedScale(duration: 220ms, curve: Curves.easeOut)`. Do NOT use `InkWell` ripples — the design has no material ink, and a ripple on a dark gradient card will look wrong. PRODUCT RULES. 1. Nothing on this screen expresses BUY / SELL / TARGET PRICE / STOP LOSS / EXPECTED RETURN, and nothing must be added. The watchlist tiles show only last price and percent change; the index strip shows level and change. Keep it that way. 2. Colour is never the sole carrier of direction: every up/down value is prefixed with ▲ or ▼ inside the same text run, and the sparkline colour merely reinforces it. Preserve the glyphs. Note the glyph spacing differs by context — the index pill is `▲ 1.24%` (with a space) and the watchlist changes are `▲1.80%` (no space). Reproduce both exactly. 3. Staleness is labelled twice on this screen and both labels are mandatory: `Updated 3 hours ago` on the index strip and `Prices delayed 15 minutes · end-of-day EGX data` under the watchlist. Drive these from real timestamps rather than hard-coding, and never render a price without a nearby age statement. RTL / LOCALISATION NOTES (direction-sensitive items on this screen). - The four Arabic company names carry an explicit `dir="rtl"`; in Flutter wrap them in `Directionality(textDirection: TextDirection.rtl)` or set `textDirection: TextDirection.rtl` on the `Text`, otherwise mixed-content lines will reorder wrongly. - The COMI unread dot is pinned `top:16px; right:16px`. Use `PositionedDirectional(top:16, end:16)` so it flips to the leading edge in RTL. - The index strip chevron `›` must become `‹` in RTL (use an `Icon` with `matchTextDirection`/`Transform.flip`, not a literal glyph). - The hero overlay pill stack is `top:14px; left:14px` and `align-items:flex-start` — mirror with `PositionedDirectional(start: 14)` and `CrossAxisAlignment.start`. - The avatar stack overlaps with `margin-left:-9px`; in RTL the stack should build right-to-left. Compute offsets with `Directionality.of(context)`. - The header row, the section header (`label` … `Manage`), and every card footer (`price` … `change`) are `space-between` rows and mirror for free with logical layout — do not hard-code `Alignment.centerLeft`. - The research rail must reverse scroll direction in RTL (`reverse: true` when RTL, or rely on `TextDirection` propagating into the `Row`). - The PRO badge is centred on the avatar (`left:50%; translateX(-50%)`) and needs no mirroring. - The hero headline contains a hard `
